paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search with HAYSTAC Phase II
notes: Combined Phase II aggregate exclusion limit over 16.96-19.46 µeV mass range at 90% CL. Paper reports |gγ| ≥ 2.86×|g_KSVZ_γ| with |g_KSVZ_γ| = 0.97 (dimensionless, from KSVZ benchmark model). Converted to canonical g_aγγ [GeV^-1] = 2.86 × 0.97 = 2.7742 GeV^-1. Flat horizontal exclusion limit. Paper excludes regions: mode crossings at 17.89-18.08 µeV and 18.13-18.18 µeV, plus 12 RFI contamination regions (~0.02% frequency coverage loss). Dark matter density: 0.45 GeV/cm³ as assumed in paper. Squeezed-state receiver measurement with average enhancement factor E=1.7 relative to quantum-limited search.
